title: WolfBite — Project 2, Team 7
description:
WolfBite is a Flutter/Firebase shopping-assistance prototype intended to help people shopping with WIC benefits look up products, manage their basket, review nutrition information, and understand checkout guidance.

This CSC 510 Project 2 update by Team 7 includes North Carolina Authorized Product List integration, clearer nutrition displays, basket-aware product-swap suggestions, interface improvements, item-level checkout help, and an automated checkout-help evaluation framework.

The project includes automated tests, installation instructions, a user guide, and Dart API documentation comments.

WolfBite uses application-managed demo allowances rather than official participant benefit accounts. Checkout-rejection scenarios and evaluation examples are synthetic; real-participant effectiveness has not been established.

This release builds on previous CSC 510 teams’ work. Their acknowledgments and existing copyright notices are retained in the repository.
